# fish completion for mnema, generated by `mnema completion fish`.
#
# For this shell, now:
#     mnema completion fish | source
# For every shell, once:
#     mnema completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/mnema.fish
#
# It completes verbs, subcommands, option names, and the values of an option whose
# declaration enumerates them, each with what its own help says. It never runs
# mnema to answer a Tab.

function __mnema_commands --description 'the subcommands one level of the tree offers'
    switch "$argv[1]"
        case ''
            echo 'init task decision skill memory observe handoff link run status focus resume next-actions guard search show timeline accountability antipatterns exposure refs skills brief key tail verify mcp repl completion help'
        case 'task'
            echo 'move'
        case 'decision'
            echo 'move supersede'
        case 'skill'
            echo 'move'
        case 'run'
            echo 'start end help'
        case 'key'
            echo 'restore request enroll revoke help'
        case 'tail'
            echo 'prune help'
    end
end

function __mnema_path --description 'the subcommand path the line has reached'
    set -l path ""
    set -l skipped 0
    for word in (commandline -opc)
        if test $skipped -eq 0
            set skipped 1
            continue
        end
        if string match -q -- '-*' "$word"
            continue
        end
        set -l children (__mnema_commands "$path" | string split ' ')
        if contains -- "$word" $children
            if test -z "$path"
                set path "$word"
            else
                set path "$path $word"
            end
        end
    end
    echo "$path"
end

function __mnema_at --description 'true when the line has reached this path'
    test (__mnema_path) = "$argv[1]"
end

complete -c mnema -e

# mnema
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'init' -d 'establish a mnema project in the current directory'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'task' -d 'create a task in the current project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'decision' -d 'record a decision in the current project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'skill' -d 'propose a reusable skill in the current project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'memory' -d 'capture a memory in the current project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'observe' -d 'record an observation about an entity in the current project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'handoff' -d 'record a handoff on a task in the current project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'link' -d 'link one piece of knowledge to another in the current project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'run' -d 'open and close the session an agent works inside'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'status' -d 'show where things stand: the work, what governs, what awaits a ruling'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'focus' -d 'show an actor\'s open runs (what they are touching now)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'resume' -d 'show where an actor left off (their latest run, open or ended)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'next-actions' -d 'show the moves the workflow allows a task next'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'guard' -d 'dry-run the gate: would a move be allowed on a task, and if not, why?'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'search' -d 'find what has been recorded, or list the most recent (no term)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'show' -d 'show one whole record by id (the body a search only pointed at)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'timeline' -d 'show an entity\'s history across the trees (subject, about, target)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'accountability' -d 'show who authorized what across the record (optionally windowed/filtered)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'antipatterns' -d 'show recurring shapes in the record (reopens, supersessions, deprecations)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'exposure' -d 'show which records hold something shaped like a credential (never the value)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'refs' -d 'show what an entity is connected to across the trees'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'skills' -d 'show where each pattern came from (who proposed it, who adopted it)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'brief' -d 'print what governs the work here as markdown, for an agent to read'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'key' -d 'manage this machine\'s signing keys'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'tail' -d 'authorize a cut in the record\'s own tails'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'verify' -d 'verify this project\'s record — its committed tree and its private one'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'mcp' -d 'run the mnema MCP server over stdio (for an agent host)'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'repl' -d 'open an interactive session that reads this project'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'completion' -d 'print the tab-completion script for a shell'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -a 'help' -d 'display help for command'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at ""' -s h -l help

# mnema tail prune
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "tail prune"' -l reason -r
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "tail prune"' -l which -r
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "tail prune"' -s h -l help
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "tail prune"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "tail prune"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'

# mnema verify
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "verify"' -l global
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "verify"' -l require -x -a 'chained signed witnessed'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "verify"' -s h -l help
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "verify"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "verify"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'

# mnema mcp
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "mcp"' -l project -r
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "mcp"' -s h -l help
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "mcp"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "mcp"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'

# mnema repl
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "repl"' -s h -l help
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "repl"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "repl"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'

# mnema completion
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "completion"' -s h -l help
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "completion"' -s V -l version
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "completion"' -l color -x -a 'auto always never'
complete -c mnema -f -n '__mnema_at "completion"' -a 'bash zsh fish'
